crossRefs.note: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe…
forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those…
For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected, if it is received with thanksgiving.

translations.web: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for something I give thanks for?
translations.bsb: If I partake in the meal with thankfulness, why am I denounced because of that for which I give thanks?
translations.kjv: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?
translations.asv: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?
